title: bole mehdi yahi alvida alvida
body:
bole mahdi yahi alvida alvida
aye hassan askari alvida alvida
deke zehre dagha tumko be jaa'n kiya
aye quda ke wali alvida alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
mo(a)tamad be sabab haaye dhaaya ghazab
aye wasie ali alvida alvida
tumko paau kahan aah mai qastajaa'n
roohe jaane naqi alvida alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
tha hidaayat se kaam aapko sub'ho shaam
ae shahe muttaqi alvida alvida
ae shahe dil doneem, ho gaya mai yateem
kaisi mout aagayi alvida alvida
